title: 第8章 这小子真TM坏！
content_zh:
四人之中最苦的就属刘济民了，只有15块钱。

    梁满囤19块钱原本不需要这么节省，但他考虑到生产队的家人，每个月最多只花十块钱，省下的钱他要寄回老家去。

    “你们尝尝这个肉！”李卫国大方地说道，见梁满囤不动筷子，李卫国直接将肉夹起放到了梁满囤的碗里。

    食堂里，刘济民倒是没客气，夹起肉放在了嘴里。

    梁满囤嘿嘿一笑，将肉放进了嘴里。他的牙齿在接触到肉的那一刹那，感觉到香味瞬间飘到自己的五脏六腑，紧接着肉在嘴里如雪糕般化开，牙齿还没反应过来，肉已经没了。

    味蕾仿佛有点遗憾，疯狂地分泌着唾液....

    杨波将自己打来的红烧肉推到四人中间：“今天的肉有点柴，大家都尝尝，我回头得找胡大头说说，好好的肉被他给做坏了！”

    刘济民知道，这是杨波让他们吃肉的借口。

    学校后勤厨师胡大头做的红烧肉是食堂一绝，一毛七分钱一份，大部分人只能一个月解一次馋。

    刘济民夹起一块肉放进嘴里，红烧肉的油水很足，不过酱油和各种调料放的很少，香味的主要来源是肉本身。

    杨波和李卫国对视了一眼，心中不禁泛起了嘀咕，平常让刘济民他们吃的时候，他们总是不愿意吃，客气好久之后才夹起一块肉放到嘴里，一直吃到用餐结束。

    “人穷志短，马瘦毛长！”刘济民见两人的样子，猜到他们的所想，于是自我调侃了一句，接着冲三人说道：“等我有钱了，我带着大家到大栅栏打牙祭，满大街溜达，想吃什么咱们吃什么！”

    刘济民这样一讲，气氛活跃了起来，梁满囤也夹了一块红烧肉放在了自己碗里。

    “等毕业了再见面，一顿饭得吃你十块钱！”杨波打趣道。

    李卫国提了提袖子，将手表露在外面，胳膊一甩，低头看了下时间：“济民，你毕业回到部队，应该会马上提干吧？”

    “我也不知道！”刘济民无奈地说道。

    杨波肯定地说道：“一定会提干的。二等功一般会马上提干，但好事儿不能全让他一个人占了。他要上大学，提干的名额就得给别人。等他大学毕业再回去，不提干就说不过去了。”

    不过要是入学前就提干，济民可是咱们几个里最有钱的，排级干部拿二十三级工资，足足有五十二块钱。”

    杨波觉得刘济民回到部队里一定会前途无量，唯一的短板是业务水平不足。

    提到业务水平，刘济民确实有点惭愧。

    “医生只能治病，但治不了思想。”刘济民笑着说道。

    刘济民觉得自己确实不是学医这块料，而且以后也不想跟血啊、器官啊打交道。

    “哎呦喂，咱们班要出军中鲁迅了？”杨波惊讶地说道。

    李卫国也对刘济民的文学水平持怀疑态度，他很想鼓励刘济民，但嘴角的笑真的憋不住：“济民，你是高中毕业，说起文化水平跟77级考上来的差不多，但当作家....有想法是好的！”

    “我觉得济民行，平常说话的时候一套一套的。现在是作家遍地走，77级里就有几个人，写的狗屁不通，但周围一群人拍马屁，走在路上都比别人神气。咱们医学院，干脆改名文学院吧！”

    梁满囤觉得自己宿舍要是能出一个作家，自己出去肯定有面子。

    现在社会上什么人最受欢迎？那肯定有作家！如今正处于思想大解放和各种思潮涌动的时期，作为思想代表的文学成为时代的宠儿。

    作家、诗人无论走到哪里都是座上宾，尤其是大学里，诗会是大学生参与度最广的活动。
content_en:
Among the four, Liu Jimin suffered the most, with only 15 yuan.

    Liang Mandun originally didn't need to save so much on 19 yuan, but considering his family members in the production team, he only spent a maximum of ten yuan every month. The money he saved would be sent back to his hometown.

    "Try this meat!" Li Weiguo said generously. Seeing that Liang Mandun couldn't move his chopsticks, Li Weiguo directly picked up the meat and put it into Liang Mandun's bowl.

    In the cafeteria, Liu Jimin was not polite and picked up the meat and put it in his mouth.

    Liang Mandun chuckled and put the meat into his mouth. The moment his teeth came into contact with the meat, he felt the fragrance instantly drifting to his internal organs. Then the meat melted in his mouth like ice cream. Before his teeth could react, the meat was gone.

    The taste buds seemed a little regretful, secreting saliva like crazy...

    Yang Bo pushed the braised pork he had brought to the middle of the four of them: "Today's meat is a little bit hot, let's all try it. I have to talk to Hu Datou later because he spoiled the good meat!"

    Liu Jimin knew that this was Yang Bo's excuse to let them eat meat.

    The braised pork cooked by Hu Datou, the school's back-office chef, is a must-have in the cafeteria. It costs 17 cents a portion, but most people can only satisfy their cravings once a month.

    Liu Jimin picked up a piece of meat and put it in his mouth. The braised pork was rich in oil and water, but very little soy sauce and various seasonings were added. The main source of the aroma was the meat itself.

    Yang Bo and Li Weiguo looked at each other and couldn't help but murmur in their hearts. When Liu Jimin and the others were asked to eat, they were always reluctant to eat. After being polite for a long time, they picked up a piece of meat and put it in their mouths, eating until the end of the meal.

    "A poor man has short ambitions, but a horse is skinny and has long hair!" Liu Jimin guessed what they were thinking when he saw their appearance, so he joked to himself, and then said to the three of them: "When I get rich, I will take everyone to Dashilan for a tooth ceremony, and walk around the streets. We can eat whatever we want!"

    When Liu Jimin said this, the atmosphere became lively, and Liang Mandun also put a piece of braised pork in his bowl.

    "When we meet again after graduation, I'll cost you ten yuan for a meal!" Yang Bo joked.

    Li Weiguo lifted up his sleeves, exposed his watch, flicked his arm, and looked down at the time: "Jimin, when you return to the army after graduation, you should be ready to join the army immediately, right?"

    "I don't know either!" Liu Jimin said helplessly.

    Yang Bo said with certainty: "He will definitely be promoted. Second-class meritorious students are usually promoted immediately, but he can't let him take all the good things. If he wants to go to college, the quota for promotion must be given to others. When he graduates from college and goes back, it will be unreasonable not to be promoted."

    However, if you mention it before entering school, Jimin is the richest among us. A platoon-level cadre gets a twenty-third-level salary, which is a full fifty-two yuan. "

    Yang Bo felt that Liu Jimin would have a bright future when he returned to the army. The only shortcoming was his insufficient professional skills.

    When it comes to professional skills, Liu Jimin is indeed a little ashamed.

    “Doctors can only cure diseases, but not thoughts. Liu Jimin said with a smile.

    Liu Jimin felt that he was indeed not qualified to study medicine, and he did not want to deal with blood or organs in the future.

    "Hey, our class is going to send out Lu Xun in the army? Yang Bo said in surprise.

    Li Weiguo was also skeptical about Liu Jimin's literary level. He wanted to encourage Liu Jimin, but he couldn't hold back the smile on his lips: "Jimin, you graduated from high school, and your cultural level is about the same as those who passed the 77th grade exam, but when it comes to being a writer... it's good to have ideas! "

    "I think Ji Minxing always talks in one way. Nowadays, writers are everywhere, and there are a few people in Level 77 who write nonsense, but they are surrounded by a group of people who flatter them, and they look more impressive than others when they walk on the road. Let’s change the name of our medical school to the School of Liberal Arts! "

    Liang Mandun felt that if there was a writer in his dormitory, he would definitely have face when he went out.

    Who is the most popular person in society now? There must be a writer! Nowadays, we are in a period of great ideological liberation and various ideological trends. Literature, as a representative of thought, has become the darling of the times.

    Writers and poets are guests wherever they go, especially in universities, where the Poetry Club is the most widely participated activity among college students.
